Subhash Vishnoi S/o Sukhdev Vishnoi, Aged About 23 Years, R/o
Peethawas, Jodhpur (Raj.)
 ----Petitioner
 Versus
1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp
2. Nikita Chaudhary D/o Sunil Chaudhary, Aged About 21
 Years, R/o House No. 09B, Shiv Mandir Road, Ratnada
 Jodhpur, P.s. Ratanada, Jodhpur.

----Respondents
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Nishank Madhan for Mr. N.K.
 Gurjar
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Prem Singh Panwar, Public
 Prosecutor
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Mukesh Rajpurohit
Order 07/08/2025
1 .  Learned counsel for the petitioner does not want to press the instant criminal misc. petition.

However, he seeks liberty for the petitioner to submit a representation to the Commissioner of Police, Jodhpur with appropriate directions to decide the same and issue necessary instructions to the concerned Investigating Officer.
2.

Accordingly, the instant criminal misc. petition as well as stay petition are dismissed as not pressed with liberty to the petitioner to submit a detailed representation to the Commissioner of Police, Jodhpur averring therein all the grounds which have been raised in this petition within a period of 10 days from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

3. In the event, the representation is submitted, the Commissioner of Police, Jodhpur is directed to minutely and objectively consider the contents of the same and thereafter, issue [2025:RJ-JD:35160] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-6368/2025] necessary instructions to the Investigating Officer.
All the relevant documents with the representation shall also be taken into consideration.
The representation shall be decided within a period of 30 days from the date of receipt of the same.

Till 30 days from the date of filing of representation, the petitioner shall not be arrested in connection with FIR No.151/2025, registered at the Police Station Ratanada, District Jodhpur City Subhash Vishnoi vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:35160) on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176893454/
1 East.
4.

entities.text: Police Station Ratanada, District Jodhpur City
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The offences alleged against the petitioner are under Sections 323, 376(2)(n), 384 of the IPC and Sections 5/6 of the POCSO Act.

Thus, the provisions contained under Section 35 of BNSS (Sections 41 and 41A of Cr.P.C.) are applicable mutatis mutandis and the judgment rendered by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar [AIR 2014 SC 2756] applies squarely in the present case, therefore, it is deemed appropriate to direct the investigating officer that in the event, the offences are found to be proved and the arrest of the petitioner are absolutely necessary,
then instead of affecting arrest at once, a prior notice of 15 days shall be given to the petitioner.

5.
